about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Charred Barbecue Corn Cobs with Smoky Paprika Lime Butter
recipes.summary: Sweet corn charred on the barbecue and brushed with smoky paprika and lime butter.
steps: Mash the butter with the paprika, lime juice, zest and salt until smooth.
Grill the corn on a hot barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning often, until tender and charred in spots.
Brush with the butter while hot and scatter with coriander.
notes: Keep the corn moving so it chars without burning.
The butter keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Campfire Foil Packet Potatoes with Herbs
recipes.summary: Baby potatoes steamed in foil with garlic and herbs, nestled in the coals.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper and divide between four large foil sheets.
Seal into tight parcels and place on hot coals or a barbecue.
Cook for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until the potatoes are completely tender when pierced.
notes: Open carefully, the steam is very hot.
No campfire needed, they work in a 200°C oven too.

recipes.title: Camp Vinegar Coleslaw
recipes.summary: A crisp, mayo-free coleslaw that holds up in the heat on camping trips and picnics.
steps: Whisk the vinegar, oil, sugar, mustard, salt and celery seeds in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Add the cabbage, carrots and onion and toss well.
Leave for 15 minutes until the cabbage softens slightly, tossing once.
notes: Keeps well in a cooler for hours because there is no mayonnaise.
Keeps for 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Barbecue Zucchini with Mint Dressing
recipes.summary: Grilled zucchini planks with a bright lemon, garlic and mint dressing.
steps: Brush the zucchini with 1 tbsp of the oil and grill on a hot barbecue for 3 to 4 minutes per side until tender and charred.
Whisk the remaining oil with the garlic, lemon juice, mint, salt and chilli.
Arrange the zucchini on a platter and spoon over the dressing.
notes: Grill in batches without crowding.
Best served warm.

recipes.title: Smoky Campfire Baked Beans
recipes.summary: Beans in a smoky tomato sauce simmered over the fire in one pot.
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over the fire or stove and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes, sugar, vinegar, tomato paste and salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick and the beans are glossy.
notes: Stir often so it does not catch on the base.
Reheats well; keeps for 4 days.

recipes.title: Campfire Foil Pack Vegetables
recipes.summary: Mixed vegetables seasoned and steamed in foil parcels, ideal for camping.
steps: Toss the vegetables with the oil, garlic, oregano and salt.
Divide between four large foil sheets and seal into tight parcels.
Cook on hot coals or a barbecue for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until the vegetables are tender.
notes: Open carefully because of hot steam.
Add a squeeze of lemon at the end.

recipes.title: Barbecue Capsicum and Onion Skewers
recipes.summary: Colourful skewers of capsicum and red onion, glazed with garlic and smoked paprika oil.
steps: Thread the capsicum and onion onto skewers.
Mix the oil, garlic, paprika, lemon juice and salt and brush over the skewers.
Grill on a hot barbecue for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and tender.
notes: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes first.
Serve with grilled meat or hummus.

recipes.title: Grilled Pineapple Spears with Chilli Lime Salt and Mint for the Barbecue
recipes.summary: Caramelised pineapple spears with a hit of chilli lime salt, great beside grilled pork.

items: 1 pineapple, peeled and cut into spears

steps: Mix the chilli, lime zest and salt together.
Brush the pineapple with the oil and grill on a hot barbecue for 3 to 4 minutes per side until charred and caramelised.
Squeeze over the lime juice, dust with the chilli salt and scatter with mint.
notes: Grill cut-side down for the best char marks.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Wholegrain Mustard Potato Salad with Crisp Bacon Bits and Gherkin
recipes.summary: A tangy potato salad with crisp bacon, gherkins and mustard dressing for barbecues.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Fry the bacon for 6 minutes until crisp and drain on paper.
Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, mustard, vinegar, gherkins, spring onions and salt, then fold through the potatoes and top with the bacon.
notes: Food safety: keep the salad chilled and do not leave it out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour in hot weather.
Keeps for 2 days.

recipes.title: Classic Macaroni Salad for Picnics
recipes.summary: A creamy elbow macaroni salad with celery, capsicum and a tangy dressing.
steps: Boil the macaroni for 9 to 10 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Fold the macaroni, celery, capsicum and onion into the dressing until coated.
notes: Food safety: keep chilled in a cooler and discard after 2 hours out of the fridge.
Loosen with a splash of milk if it thickens.

recipes.title: Camp Cucumber and Yoghurt Salad
recipes.summary: A cooling cucumber and mint salad that needs no cooking, ideal beside spicy barbecue food.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, garlic, lemon juice, oil and salt in a bowl.
Fold through the cucumber and mint and leave for 5 minutes until the flavours blend.
Taste and adjust the lemon and salt, then keep chilled.
notes: Keep it in a cooler until serving.
Best within 4 hours.

recipes.title: Camp Tuna Pasta Salad
recipes.summary: A filling tinned tuna and pasta salad with tomatoes, olives and lemon, easy to pack.

items: 2 x 185g tins tuna in olive oil, drained

steps: Boil the pasta for 10 minutes until al dente, drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and salt.
Toss the pasta with the tuna, tomatoes, olives, onion, parsley and dressing until coated.
notes: Food safety: keep chilled and eat within 2 hours of leaving the cooler.
Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Barbecue Eggplant with Garlic Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Smoky grilled eggplant slices with a garlic yoghurt sauce and parsley.
steps: Brush the eggplant with the oil and salt and grill on a hot barbecue for 5 to 7 minutes per side until soft and deeply charred.
Mix the yoghurt, garlic and lemon juice.
Spoon the yoghurt over the eggplant and scatter with parsley and chilli.
notes: Salting first for 10 minutes reduces bitterness, rinse and pat dry before oiling.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Foil Wrapped Herb Garlic Baguette Baked on Campfire Coals
recipes.summary: A crusty baguette stuffed with garlic and herb butter, warmed in foil on the coals.
steps: Mix the butter, garlic, parsley, oregano and salt until smooth.
Slice the baguette almost through at 3cm intervals and spread the butter between the slices.
Wrap tightly in foil and heat on hot coals or a 200°C oven for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until hot and the butter has melted.
notes: Open the foil for the last 3 minutes for a crisper crust.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Tuna Protein Salad
recipes.summary: A high protein lunch salad of chickpeas, tinned tuna and crunchy vegetables with a lemon dressing.

items: 185g tin tuna in olive oil, drained

steps: Combine the chickpeas, tuna, cucumber, tomatoes and onion in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and salt.
Toss the dressing and parsley through the salad until evenly coated.
notes: Food safety: keep refrigerated and eat within 2 days.
Add chilli flakes for a kick.

recipes.title: High Protein Shredded Chicken Quinoa Bowl with Cucumber Mint and Lemon Tahini
recipes.summary: Quinoa, shredded chicken and crisp vegetables with a creamy lemon tahini dressing.
steps: Simmer the quinoa in 400ml water for 15 minutes until tender and the water is absorbed, then fluff and cool.
Poach the chicken in simmering water for 12 to 14 minutes until cooked through at 75°C, then shred.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, water, oil and salt, then toss with the quinoa, chicken, cucumber, tomatoes and mint.
notes: Food safety: make sure the chicken reaches 75°C in the thickest part and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Keeps for 2 days.

recipes.title: Lentil and Feta Protein Salad
recipes.summary: Earthy green lentils with feta, cucumber and herbs in a red wine vinaigrette.
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 18 to 20 minutes until tender but holding their shape, then drain and cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and salt.
Toss the lentils with the cucumber, tomatoes, onion, parsley and dressing, then top with the feta.
notes: Cook the lentils gently so they do not turn mushy.
Keeps for 3 days.

recipes.title: Protein Packed Edamame Baked Tofu Cubes and Cabbage with Ginger Sesame Dressing
recipes.summary: Crisp baked tofu with edamame and cabbage in a ginger and sesame dressing.
steps: Toss the tofu with 1 tbsp soy sauce, the cornflour and vegetable oil and bake at 220°C for 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes until tender, then drain and cool.
Whisk the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger and honey, then toss with the cabbage, carrot, edamame and tofu and top with sesame seeds.
notes: Press the tofu in paper towel first for crisper cubes.
Keeps for 2 days.

recipes.title: Egg and Lentil Salad with Mustard Dressing
recipes.summary: Hard-boiled eggs over green lentils, rocket and a sharp mustard dressing.
steps: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and cool.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until hard-set, cool in cold water and peel.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt, toss with the lentils, rocket and tomatoes and top with halved eggs.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm, keep the salad chilled and eat within 2 days.
Add capers for extra bite.

recipes.title: Flaked Salmon Cannellini Bean Lunch Salad with Dill Lemon and Rocket
recipes.summary: Flaked tinned salmon with creamy white beans, rocket and a dill and lemon dressing.
steps: Flake the salmon into a bowl, removing any large bones.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, dill and salt.
Toss the beans, onion, rocket and salmon with the dressing until just combined.
notes: Food safety: tinned salmon is already cooked and opaque, and it flakes easily; discard it if it smells off; keep the salad refrigerated and eat within 2 days.
Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Seared Beef Salad with Cucumber, Mint and Lime Chilli Dressing
recipes.summary: Seared beef strips with cucumber, herbs and a lime and fish sauce dressing.
steps: Season the beef and sear in the oil in a hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side until medium, then rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Stir the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chillies until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the cucumber, onion and herbs with the beef and dressing.
notes: Food safety: whole cuts like steak can be eaten medium, but cook until at least 63°C in the centre; mince should always be well done.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Salad Bowl with Black Beans
recipes.summary: A crunchy taco salad with spiced chicken, beans, corn and a lime yoghurt dressing.
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, cumin, paprika and half the salt and cook in a hot pan for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through at 75°C.
Whisk the yoghurt with the lime juice and remaining salt.
Assemble the lettuce, beans, corn, tomatoes, avocado and chicken in bowls and drizzle with the dressing.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest part and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Add crushed corn chips for crunch.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken and Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: Lemony grilled chicken with chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, olives and feta.
steps: Rub the chicken with 1 tbsp of the oil, the lemon juice and oregano and cook in a hot pan for 6 to 7 minutes per side until cooked through at 75°C, then rest and slice.
Whisk the remaining oil and the vinegar.
Toss the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives and onion with the dressing and top with the chicken and feta.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest part and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Serve with pita bread.

recipes.title: Prawn and Quinoa Salad with Lime
recipes.summary: Garlic prawns over quinoa with avocado, cucumber and a lime dressing.
steps: Simmer the quinoa in 300ml water for 15 minutes until tender, then fluff and cool.
Cook the prawns with the garlic in 1 tbsp of the oil for 3 to 4 minutes until pink and opaque throughout.
Whisk the remaining oil, lime juice and salt, then toss with the quinoa, avocado, cucumber, tomatoes, coriander and prawns.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, keep the salad chilled and eat within 1 day.
Add chilli if you like heat.
